collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - VILLAGE MOMENTS (VFX-01..12, draft for the owner, 2026-11-18)
Songs, chants and speeches, a long lazy afternoon, rain on the way, a roof patched with cloth: small moments where the whole village does something together, and the island answers.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A thick morning mist: let it settle, or light the fires to clear it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (name1) wakes to find the whole village wrapped in a white mist so thick (he/she) cannot see the next hut. Somewhere in it, the children are laughing.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The village moves slowly through the mist all morning, calling out to each other so nobody gets lost. It is strange and quiet and rather beautiful.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) builds up the fires until the warmth and smoke chase the mist away, and by midmorning the sky is clear and blue.
